title: Normal depth in partly full circular pipes
description: Three chains of ten 1 m circular pipes (n = 0.013, slope 0.002) carry 0.15, 0.5 and 1.0 m³/s to normal-depth outfalls, filling them to about a quarter, a half and three quarters. At steady state every interior manhole and every pipe runs at Manning normal depth in the exact circular section.

citations.title: Storm Water Management Model Reference Manual Volume II – Hydraulics (EPA/600/R-17/111)

criteria.rationale: Worst node or pipe depth within 1 cm (1 % of the diameter). SWMM-family engines store circular-pipe area and hydraulic radius in 51-entry tables and interpolate between them; that alone moves a normal depth by a few millimetres.
Pipe flows within 0.5 %: at steady state every pipe carries its chain's inflow.

convergence.not_applicable: A link–node network with a closed-form (or 1e-11 integrated) reference at fixed elements: there is no grid to refine.
